name: Our Last Spring
source: After spring break these students return to school to find that it is their last semester. They realize that everything they once knew was ending and they were on the precipice of their new lives. This leads to interesting revelations and the desire to live life to the fullest before they leave school and go out into the wide world. Follow these 10 characters as they experiment sexually and discover secrets about their fellow students.
translation: 春假结束后，这些学生回到学校，发现这是他们的最后一个学期。他们意识到他们曾经所知道的一切都在结束，他们正处于新生活的悬崖边。这会带来有趣的启示，并让他们渴望在离开学校走向广阔的世界之前过上充实的生活。跟随这10个角色进行性实验并发现同学的秘密。
